review_candidates.title: Facade design manager
review_candidates.description: Location: Madinaty, Cairo Employment Type: Contract-Based / Full time Project: Mixed-use High-rise / Residence / Office / Hotel / Entertainment / Intrastructure Project Type & Scope: PM/CM Overview The Facade Design Manager will oversee the facade design process from concept development through detailed design and shop drawing review, ensuring that architectural intent is achieved while maintaining technical feasibility and constructability. The role will be responsible for verifying that all facade systems comply with applicable international standards, local building codes, energy efficiency requirements, and project specifications. The Facade Design Manager will coordinate technical interfaces among architects, structural engineers, MEP consultants, and facade contractors to identify and resolve design conflicts, ensuring seamless integration across disciplines. In addition, the role will lead the material review and approval process and oversee facade performance testing, including mock-ups and performance mock-up unit (PMU) testing, to validate the performance, durability, and quality of glass, aluminum, stone, and other cladding systems throughout the project lifecycle. Responsibilities • Technical Review: Conduct rigorous review and approval of facade-related drawings, calculations, specifications, and Building Maintenance Unit (BMU) designs. • Value Engineering: Propose alternative facade systems and cost-saving measures without compromising performance or quality. • Risk Management: Proactively identify and mitigate potential technical risks such as water leakage, structural failures, thermal bridging, and air infiltration. • Site Inspection & QA/QC: Oversee on-site installation to ensure adherence to approved drawings and maintain high-quality workmanship. • Testing Oversight: Witness and analyze Performance Mock-up (PMU) tests and on-site water testing to validate system integrity. • Contractor Management: Evaluate the technical capabilities of facade subcontractors and monitor their progress and deliverables. Qualifications • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Facade Engineering, Structural/Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. • Minimum 15+ years of demonstrable experience in facade design and construction management, with a proven track record in large-scale complex projects. • Deep understanding of various facade systems (Unitized Curtain Wall, Point-supported, GRC, etc.). • Proficiency in CAD/BIM software (AutoCAD, Revit, Rhino) and facade structural analysis tools. • Strong knowledge of modern insulation, fire safety standards, and sustainability (LEED/BREEAM). • Soft Skills: Excellent leadership, decision-making, and communication skills to coordinate between diverse technical teams and clients. Preferred • Tier 1 Background: Experience and background in a Tier 1 Construction company or international PMC. • Project Portfolio: * Experience in High-rise building construction (more than 100m or 33 floors). • Experience in Luxury residence, Office building, or 5-star Hotel interior/exterior work (5 years or 3 projects). • Regional Exposure: Exposure to Egyptian or Middle East regulatory environments and local codes. • Language: Professional English proficiency is a must for reporting and technical coordination.

review_candidates.title: Electrical Engineers (Senior to Associate) - Mission Critical Building Services
review_candidates.description: Senior to Associate Electrical Engineers - Mission Critical Building Services Competitive salary based on level and experience Manchester, London or Glasgow | Hybrid working Permanent | Full-Time We are supporting a major international engineering consultancy with several appointments across its UK mission-critical building services team. The business works with some of the world’s leading hyperscale data centre operators, technology companies and colocation providers, supported by an excellent pipeline of UK and European projects. What makes this opportunity particularly interesting is the position of the business in the market. Globally, it offers the technical capability, client relationships and project security of a major Tier 1 consultancy. In the UK and Europe, however, the team remains comparatively lean and is entering a significant period of growth. That creates a rare combination: the backing and resources of a major international organisation, with the visibility, influence and progression more commonly associated with a smaller business. You would be joining at a stage where your contribution can genuinely help shape how the team develops, while still benefiting from established clients, secured workload and access to international technical expertise. The role You will support the design and delivery of resilient electrical systems for complex, mission-critical developments. Depending on your level, this may include LV and MV power distribution, UPS and standby generation, critical power systems, earthing, protection and resilience strategies. You may also be involved in technical reviews, specifications, multidisciplinary coordination, client engagement and project leadership. At Principal and Associate level, the role will include wider responsibility for technical leadership, mentoring engineers, overseeing delivery and contributing to the future direction of the electrical team. Why this stands out This is not simply another opportunity to join a large, established data centre team. The UK operation is still at a stage where good engineers can be visible, bring ideas forward and have a genuine influence on standards, processes and team development. At the same time, you are not taking the risk associated with joining a smaller consultancy that may have a limited pipeline or depend heavily on a small number of clients. The business offers access to major international data centre programmes, strong long-term workload and direct collaboration with senior leaders and global technical specialists. I have worked with the organisation for more than a year and have placed several people across the business. The feedback has been consistently positive, particularly around the culture, recognition, project exposure and investment in employees. Your background Previous data centre experience would be highly relevant, but it is not essential. The business is also interested in Electrical Engineers who have worked in other environments where resilience, continuity and system reliability are critical. This could include healthcare, broadcasting, pharmaceutical, advanced manufacturing, laboratories, airports, defence or other technically complex buildings. You should have a strong electrical building services design background, experience working within multidisciplinary teams and a sound understanding of resilient electrical infrastructure. Chartered status would be welcomed, particularly at Principal and Associate level, although engineers working towards chartership will also be considered. To apply, please submit your CV, or for a confidential discussion, contact Dean Forster at Tempest Jones on dean@tempestjones.com.
